desc:
Framer SEO and page speed optimization makes your site easier for search engines to understand and quicker for visitors to load. Ecom Swift LLC reviews your structure, metadata, images, fonts and scripts, fixes what is missing or heavy, and connects Search Console.

## What is Framer SEO and page speed optimization?

Framer SEO and page speed optimization is the work of making a Framer site clear to search engines and light for browsers. It covers page titles, descriptions, heading order, link text, image names, sitemaps, structured data, and the weight of images, fonts and scripts.

Framer sites can be quick and search friendly, but only when they are set up with care. Defaults help. They do not replace a review of what each page says and how much it loads.

## Why good sites still go unfound

A site can look excellent and be nearly invisible. Pages share the same title, so search results look identical. Headings are chosen for size, not meaning, so the page outline makes no sense to a crawler. Images carry names like "IMG_2043" and no description. A hero video loads before any text, and visitors on phones leave before it finishes.

These are quiet problems. Nothing looks broken in the editor. They only appear in search results, in speed tests and in the behavior of impatient visitors.

## How the work improves visibility and visitor experience

Clear titles and descriptions tell searchers what each page offers, which helps the right people click. A logical heading order and descriptive link text help search engines read the page. Alt text helps people who use screen readers and gives images context.

Speed supports all of it. Lighter images, fewer scripts and trimmed effects let pages appear sooner, which matters most on phones. Faster pages are easier to use and leave less reason to abandon the visit. Search rankings depend on many factors, including competition and content quality, so we cannot promise a position.

## What a solid Framer SEO and speed setup includes

- A unique title and description for every important page.
- One clear main heading per page, with sub-headings in order.
- Descriptive link text instead of "click here".
- Images resized, compressed and given useful file names and alt text.
- Fonts limited to the weights and styles actually used.
- Heavy effects and unneeded scripts removed or delayed.
- Social sharing images for links shared on other platforms.
- A sitemap that is submitted and checked in Search Console.
- Structured data on key pages where it applies.
- Redirects and error pages cleaned up, with CMS templates that generate titles automatically.

## How we work

We run speed tests on your key pages before changing anything, so you have a baseline. Then we audit the content structure, apply fixes in a duplicate of your project and test again. You receive before and after results and a short list of content ideas.

Basic covers metadata, heading structure and image compression on your top pages, with a sitemap and indexing check. Standard widens the work across more pages, sets social images, trims fonts and scripts, writes alt text and connects Search Console. Premium covers a larger page set, CMS templates that build titles on their own, structured data, redirect and error fixes, a three-month keyword plan and a period of follow-up fixes.

Changes are made to be invisible: your design stays the same unless a heavy effect needs to be simplified, and we tell you first if it does.

## Do and avoid

**Do:**
- Write titles for people first and search engines second.
- Use one main topic per page.
- Compress images before they reach the project.
- Keep the number of fonts small.
- Check results in Search Console a few weeks after changes.

**Avoid:**
- Repeating the same title across many pages.
- Stuffing pages with keywords.
- Using huge background videos on every page.
- Hiding important text inside images.
- Expecting overnight changes in search results.

## Who this is for

A small business that wants local customers to find it, a consultant whose Framer site looks good but gets few visits, and a startup preparing to publish regular content all benefit. It also suits owners whose site feels slow on phones and who need help finding why.

## What we need from you

Send your site address, the pages and topics that matter most and the terms you hope to be found for. Invite us to your Framer project as a collaborator. For Search Console, add us as a user with the access level that allows setup, or send a verified property link through the tool itself. We never need your password.

Tell us if parts of the design must not change, so we can plan around them.
